## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and link the issue.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Linked issue criteria met, or PR kept draft with remaining work listed.
- [ ] Permission/data boundaries and relevant concurrent-write behavior reviewed.
- [ ] Migrations and handover notes updated where needed.

## Verification

List exact checks and actual results; distinguish PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED and NOT RUN.

## Remaining work / risks

Record unfinished features, policy dependencies and rollout/rollback requirements. No credentials or real participant records.
